title: README SDK examples: initial test round
Goal: Check each direct SDK promise with the actual no-key engine.
Action: Run ten installed-client cases in temporary roots.
Expected: Files, recall, sources, state, and errors match the proposed README.
Actual: Nine cases passed. One new reset test failed because it assumed the logical UUID must change. That assumption was not a SDK guarantee.
App meaning: Document the native capture/routing contract. Do not promise a new UUID.

title: README SDK examples: final real-engine round
Goal: Verify the executable quickstart and all direct SDK scenarios.
Action: Run the ten-case suite. Rerun the strengthened symmetric routing case.
Expected: Each named case has observable native/source/file assertions.
Actual: All ten passed. The quickstart function is executed by SDK-01. Reset capture and same-note-ID corpus separation passed.
App meaning: The SDK can store and recall your chosen notes. It does not create agent replies or automatic model lifecycle work.

title: Native model capabilities: historical record audit
Goal: Check the evidence behind semantic recall and native model lifecycle examples.
Action: Read retained genuine-provider records; verify source/state/publication assertions.
Expected: Each native claim has its specific accepted evidence.
Actual: Six audits passed. Changed-fact supersession is skipped. No model request was sent.
App meaning: Native capabilities are real historical results. They are not new SDK generation tests.
Status: EVIDENCE AUDIT PASS; FRESH MODEL NOT TESTED

title: Transport failures and native CI mapping
Goal: Keep lower-level error coverage separate from happy-path acceptance.
Action: Run three SDK protocol fixture tests. Map native/config cases to the successful exact-commit CI logs.
Expected: Failure handling remains covered, and existing cases are retained.
Actual: Three fixture tests passed. Native borrowed ownership, deterministic maintenance, config validation, and 81-test CI remain separate evidence. No old tests were removed.
App meaning: Do not remove most tests after a scenario pass. Different entry points and failure modes still need their own checks.
Status: PASS — fixture checks and verified CI mapping

title: Explicit quickstart source-range context
Goal: Make the application carry the source path and lines, without relying on automatic snippet citations.
Action: Add a failing exact-format assertion, then add the same path/range prefix to executable and inline code.
Expected: Every returned source contributes [path:Lstart-Lend] to the prompt.
Actual: The old code had native automatic citations but no explicit prefix. After the change, the real SDK-01 case passed.
App meaning: The app now supplies an explicit source range with each recalled snippet. It still does not generate an agent reply.

title: Actual gated model runner and measured-run mapping
Goal: Provide executable feature tests, not substitute JSON audits for real model behavior.
Action: Reuse fixed native runners behind explicit family gates. Run MODEL-01 against the real provider after cumulative budget preflight. Map the other families to their measured actual runs.
Expected: A fresh selected case executes native work. Unselected or consumed workflows do not silently reuse an old record.
Actual: MODEL-01 passed fresh in 27.59 seconds. Its native runner asserted embedding/synonym/source behavior. Lifecycle and merge/Diary ledgers remain consumed; their actual prior stage results and matching assertions are recorded separately. Supersession is not verified.
App meaning: Model capabilities are native/CLI tests. Python SDK generation is not claimed. A record audit only checks consistency.
Status: MODEL-01 fresh PASS; other measured stages PASS; other fresh families NOT RUN
